name: Nekoneko Mistress
source:
The basic story is that the main character is a mouse guy who secretly breaks into that mansion in search of the "legendary cheese". This cheese is supposed to have the power to enlarge him.
However he gets caught by the two cat maids working in there (and whose boss is a real masochistic BDSM type, for instance he dresses the maids in leather).
The entire game is about degradation of the main character and also the owner of the mansion.

[Edited from the forum [url=http://aryion.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=18&t=1131&start=30]Eka's portal[/url]]
translation:
故事的主人公是一名鼠人，他为了寻找“传说中的奶酪”，偷偷潜入一座宅邸。据说这种奶酪能让他的身体变大。
然而，他被宅邸里的两名猫女仆抓住了。她们的主人是个不折不扣的受虐狂兼BDSM爱好者，比如会让女仆穿上皮衣。
整部游戏围绕主人公与宅邸主人的屈辱经历展开。
